source_note: Dữ liệu thật crawl từ website chính hãng jemi.es (bản tiếng Anh /en/) ngày 18/07/2026. Thông số kỹ thuật lấy từ các trang danh mục (undercounter/dome/tunnel/utensil) vì trang chi tiết từng model render bằng JavaScript nên không đọc được qua fetch. Mỗi model đều có source_url thật đang hoạt động. image_url để trống do ảnh sản phẩm nạp động (JS), không lấy được URL tĩnh — cần bổ sung thủ công.

models.title: GS 40S
models.description_en: Tech Line undercounter glasswasher with 400x400 basket. AISI 304 stainless steel, electromechanical control, rotary wash system, double-walled structure, magnetic safety door and digital temperature display.

models.description_en: Tech Line undercounter glasswasher/dishwasher with 290 mm useful height for both glasses and plates. AISI 304 stainless steel, rotary wash system, double-walled structure, magnetic safety door and digital temperature display.

models.title: GS 50
models.description_en: Tech Line undercounter dishwasher/glasswasher with 500x500 basket and 360 mm useful height. AISI 304 stainless steel, rotary wash system, double-walled structure, magnetic safety door and digital temperature display.

models.description_en: Tech Line undercounter dishwasher, three-phase version of the GS 50 with higher installed power. AISI 304 stainless steel, rotary wash system, double-walled structure and magnetic safety door.

models.title: GS 60
models.description_en: Tech Line undercounter dishwasher able to wash plates, GN trays and 600x400 boxes. AISI 304 stainless steel, rotary wash system, double-walled structure and magnetic safety door.
